newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cement maker CBR sees 1996 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Cement maker CBR sees 1996 profit up.

text.p: Leading Belgian cement maker CBR said on Friday it expected full year group net profit in 1996 to show an improvement on the 1995 figure.
Last year the firm made a consolidated net profit of 5.022 billion francs.

"Group net profit for 1996 should be higher than in 1995," it said in a statement. "The group will already benefit in 1996 from the increased stakeholdings in subsidiaries made over the course of the year in Europe."

"The Turkish acquisition is not expected to have an impact on the net income for the year and the improvement currently under way in North America is expected to intensify in the second half of the year," it added.
